categories.main_business_segments: Yungjin Pharm Co., Ltd. primarily operates in pharmaceutical manufacturing and sales, focusing on prescription drugs including enteral nutrition products, respiratory fibrosis treatments, antibiotics, and raw materials. The company also engages in contract manufacturing (CMO) and exports pharmaceutical products and raw materials internationally.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced pharmaceutical manufacturing technologies including tablet, capsule, syrup, and injectable production lines. It emphasizes innovative drug development, including new chemical entities and improved formulations, supported by robust R&D in synthetic drugs, biologics, and bioequivalence studies. Production capacity is supported by modern facilities with high utilization rates and ongoing expansion projects.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Yungjin Pharm serves hospitals, pharmacies, and healthcare providers domestically, with a significant portion of sales in respiratory, cardiovascular, anti-inflammatory, and antibiotic drug categories. Internationally, it targets markets in Japan, China, and other countries through exports and licensing agreements, focusing on antibiotics and raw materials.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in South Korea with domestic sales accounting for nearly 90% of revenue. It has established export markets in Japan and other countries, with ongoing efforts to expand global presence through licensing and partnerships, particularly in the US and Europe.
categories.supply_chain_position: Yungjin Pharm operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the pharmaceutical supply chain, focusing on drug formulation, manufacturing, and sales. It also engages in upstream activities through in-house R&D and raw material sourcing but relies on imports for certain key raw materials.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovative drug development targeting unmet medical needs, including COPD, rheumatoid arthritis, and rare mitochondrial diseases. It invests heavily in R&D for new chemical entities, improved formulations, and bioequivalence studies, while expanding its pipeline through licensing-in and licensing-out agreements. ESG and ethical management are also strategic priorities.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through the sale of pharmaceutical products domestically and internationally, including prescription drugs, raw materials, and contract manufacturing services. Additional income streams include licensing fees, milestone payments from out-licensed products, and rental income from property assets.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Yungjin Pharm is positioned as a mid-sized pharmaceutical company within the South Korean market, competing with larger firms such as Yuhan, Chong Kun Dang, and Green Cross. It differentiates through strong export capabilities, innovative R&D, and strategic partnerships, maintaining a competitive stance in both domestic and select global markets.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of 2023, Yungjin Pharm reported revenues of approximately KRW 234.9 billion, reflecting a 7.6% year-over-year growth and achieving record sales. The company returned to operating profitability with an operating income of KRW 3.1 billion. Total assets stood at KRW 226.6 billion, with steady growth in current assets and liabilities reflecting increased operational scale and financing activities.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Yungjin Pharm emphasizes innovative pharmaceutical products with proven efficacy in chronic and rare diseases, supported by strong R&D capabilities and a diversified product portfolio. Its competitive edge lies in its export proficiency, ethical management certifications (ISO37001, ISO14001, ISO45001), and strategic licensing partnerships that enhance its global market reach and pipeline robustness.
